implementationContract.choiceAndEvidence: Offer time to browse, choose, read or revisit with support. Repeat invitations with a different appropriate collection or access arrangement. Record actual available resources, assistance, choices and voluntarily shared reasons. Declining, quiet engagement or a changed preference does not justify a negative mastery label; scarcity and unfamiliar language are recorded separately.
implementationContract.specificR1Loan: For Preparatory R1 C-5.1, provide actual repeated library-loan and home-reading opportunities with accessible books and a workable return/revisit route. A classroom library qualifies only if it genuinely lends materials. A library picture, one-off classroom browsing or invented home-reading log does not fulfil this particular duty. No home photograph or private family disclosure is needed.
implementationContract.otherRecordBoundary: Foundation and R2 retain varied actual-role choice/reading duties without importing the specific R1 home-loan requirement. Literacy accuracy, fluency, recommendation skill and R1/R2 language configuration remain separate. Neither English nor a Hindi/English pair is imposed.
implementationContract.independentR1Goal: Review actual repeated access/choice context, genuine borrowing/home-reading opportunities and developing or changing preferences together. Do not infer the goal from its two child labels, oral-reading accuracy or compliance. Provide support and voice without guaranteeing enjoyment.
implementationContract.unfulfilledDeliveryRule: Missing actual materials, a loan route or observations are recorded as unfulfilled implementation conditions. The protocol does not certify supplied school provision or completed learner participation.
